diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~292% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.548), which favours a selective combination.
